data.title: 圣女贞德 · 圣泉湿身的白蕾丝独奏·「这里……只有神与我在注视」
data.description: 【教堂后院的圣泉浴池·深夜】月色下，贞德斜倚在圣泉池边，白色蕾丝内衣被泉水浸得半透，紧贴着丰盈的白皙曲线。她仰起泛红的脸颊，一只手在水面之下颤动着抚过最圣洁的花瓣，湿润的金发漂散在水中如融化的月光——眼泪混着水汽从眼角滑落，圣女第一次承认：原来被触碰的渴望，从来都不是罪。
data.action: 斜倚池边湿身半透白蕾丝，水下手指颤动自慰，仰头泛红失神落泪
data.lighting: 清冷月光与水下烛光交映，湿透蕾丝泛着水光
data.camera: medium shot, moonlit spring, wet translucent lace, sensual solo framing
data.promptProse: Reclining against the rim of a moonlit holy spring behind the chapel, Jeanne d'Arc wears her angelic white lace lingerie soaked to translucent sheerness, clinging to the full pale curves of her chest. Water beads roll down her collarbone as one trembling hand glides beneath the surface between her parted thighs, wet blonde hair drifting across the water like melted moonlight. Tears mingle with steam on her flushed cheeks as she finally admits the yearning to be touched was never a sin. Sensual solo composition, wet translucent fabric, cinematic lighting, moon haze, detailed stone spring background.
